g.text: 1. Give consent; submit symptoms and answers
4. Red flag: emergency advice now. Otherwise continue
5. One transaction: consultation PENDING_PAYMENT (10 min timer) + outbox event
6. Coverage check: insured? the patient's share (co-payment)
7. POST /payments: patient's share, reference, callback URL, Idempotency-Key
9. Redirect to checkout, or 'approve on your phone'
10. Pay with mobile money or card
